big_case.notes: Self-represented petition from an unpublished Fourth Circuit per curiam affirming a Rule 12 dismissal of an individual whistleblower-retaliation suit on threshold grounds; the questions presented are abstract and present no split or question of general importance. No response, no amicus, denied at first conference without a writing. The defendant's size and the petition's national-security allegations do not give the legal dispute wider stakes.

leakage.notes: Log mode forward; prediction created 2026-10-31, before the 2026-11-13 conference and the 2026-11-16 denial. Calls are provisioned-record reads, statpack reads, two corpus queries for unrelated denials, two web searches (unobserved results; queries concern Murray v. UBS and Rule 10, not this petition) and CourtListener lookups of Murray (601 U.S. 23). The one legible retrieved_doc_date (2026-04-29) predates resolution. Nothing in the log or prose shows this petition's disposition; the reasoning treats the conference as still future.
